scope: Corollary 11 (High-average-accuracy majority obstruction) of the manuscript “Product-projection localization and the QAC0 parity lower bound” (preprints/Product-projection-localization-and-the-QAC0-parity-lower-bound-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 274 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 12393c9f997aa808), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed δ > 0, no nonuniform family (Cn) in the circuit model of Theorem 1, with fixed depth and polynomially many total qubits, satisfies 2−n ∑︂ x∈{0,1}n fCn (x)(−1)MAJn(x) ≥ 1 − n−δ for all sufficiently large n. Here fCn (x) ∈ [−1, 1] is the expected measured sign: the probability of output zero minus the probability of output one. Equivalently, no such family computes strict majority with average success at least 1 − 1 2n−δ, where the average is over uniform inputs and the output measurement.
